elements.text: **Joining instructions.** Doors open at 09:00. Bring the confirmation email — the code in it looks like `WS-2417`. Read the [venue access notes](https://example.com/venue) before you travel, or write to [the organizers](mailto:workshops@example.com).

Please bring:

- A laptop with a current browser
- Your **photo ID**
- ~~A printed ticket~~ (no longer needed)

# Cancellation

Cancel at least 14 days ahead for a full refund.
Refunds are issued to the original payment method. See the [old policy page](http://example.com/policy-2019).
Rates are 120 EUR* per seat (*excluding VAT).
This notice was authored for a markup language this renderer set does not implement.
Seats are held for **15 minutes** after you submit. See the [booking terms](https://example.com/terms).
